structural_validity.description: Is the overall reasoning process sound?

constraint_compliance.description: Did evaluators follow their instructions (cite spans, check exceptions, trace definitions)?

grounding_quality.description: Are evaluators reasoning from contract text or general legal knowledge?

consistency_issues.description: Any logical contradictions found in evaluator reasoning

challenge_survival.description: Does the reasoning survive the evidence challenges?

span_overlap_assessment.description: Do agreeing evaluators cite similar spans?
